verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint extracts tables. Its table-output-formats docs say tables can be returned in several formats and that the chosen format affects how merged cells, headers and structure are represented, which covers part of the story. The evidence never names HTML or markdown as output formats, never mentions tables spanning multiple pages, and offers no hands-on check of fidelity. Missing for 10: explicit HTML/markdown table output, multi-page table stitching, nested-header handling detail, independent corroboration of complex-table accuracy.
